task: B04 agent release independent evaluation round 2
summary: Round 2 closes the first verdict's concrete POSIX lock, POSIX rollback-containment, and PowerShell argument-redaction findings at the code and fixture level. A native Linux systemd fixture also passed install, upgrade, offline rollback, retained-data checks, and supervisor kill/restart. B04 is still not releasable: the public manifest pins the pre-B04 baseline, no agent/v* tag or remote candidate ref exists, the Windows test has not run on Windows, native macOS launchd was not exercised, and the required cross-platform cutover fault matrix remains incomplete.

prior_finding_disposition.detail: src/shared/agent-releases.json still maps 1.4.0 to 2074991717abaf3cb34d9aad894bcd4357fefbc3. Candidate c8c79cf7bb112b33010c05f3332ec7a12c1b88f7 is absent from origin refs, and origin advertises no agent/v* tags. This is correctly documented as an unfinished two-commit release sequence, not fixed in the candidate.

A meaningful native-Windows-only Vitest fixture was added, but it skipped on macOS and Linux. No PowerShell parser/runtime, directory cutover, FileStream lock, Task Scheduler, or restore result from native Windows is available yet.

Native Ubuntu 25.10 arm64 with Node 22.23.3 and a running systemd user manager passed real npm ci, first install, upgrade, offline rollback, queue/credential retention, and systemd SIGKILL restart using a local immutable Git/manifest fixture. Native macOS launchd, Linux cron fallback runtime, Windows Task Scheduler, disk-full, native dependency failure, and installer-kill cutover windows remain unverified.

POSIX now holds a PID/start-time lock and recovers a stale primary lock after SIGKILL; Windows uses a kernel FileStream with FileShare.None. Concurrent POSIX fixture execution failed closed without changing the active release. The Windows path still requires native CI evidence. A SIGKILL during POSIX recovery-guard ownership can leave .install.lock.recover requiring the documented manual removal, so kill-window coverage remains part of the platform matrix.

POSIX rollback canonicalizes both app and previous targets and rejects targets outside ~/.tokenizer/releases before service stop or cutover. The fixture proved an escaped symlink is rejected while the active commit remains unchanged. Windows uses lexical GetFullPath/StartsWith containment and still requires native reparse-point testing.

PowerShell no longer includes arguments in Invoke-Checked failures and suppresses every stream for enrollment commands. Static assertions passed, but the token-canary execution is Windows-only and has not run in this evaluation environment.

blocking_findings.title: The exact B04 candidate is not published by an immutable release manifest
evidence: Candidate c8c79cf7bb112b33010c05f3332ec7a12c1b88f7 is absent from git ls-remote origin output.
git ls-remote --tags origin refs/tags/agent/v* returns no tags.
blocking_findings.required_action: After platform acceptance, create a new release commit A/version, publish immutable tag agent/vX.Y.Z at A, then commit B with the full A SHA in the ledger. Verify endpoint output, tag target, and remote fetchability before any Agent rollout.

blocking_findings.title: Native Windows acceptance is still absent
evidence: pwsh/Windows is unavailable on the evaluator host.
The existing Windows service suite skipped four Windows-only cases on both executed hosts.
blocking_findings.required_action: Run the pull-request verify-windows job and preserve its native output. Require the new installer fixture, install.ps1 parser check, service tests, and Task Scheduler install/upgrade/rollback checks to pass before advertising a Windows Agent.

blocking_findings.title: macOS launchd and the cross-platform cutover fault matrix remain incomplete
evidence: The macOS host already runs a real cc.tokenizer.agent launchd job, so this evaluator did not disrupt it; macOS installer coverage remained --no-service with mocked npm/CLI.
Linux systemd normal install/upgrade/offline rollback and service SIGKILL restart passed, but disk-full and SIGKILL at each directory/symlink cutover boundary were not injected.
Linux cron fallback runtime and native dependency-install failure were not exercised.
blocking_findings.required_action: Run isolated macOS launchd and Windows Task Scheduler hosts plus the remaining disk-full, dependency-failure, and process-kill cutover matrix. Retain logs and data canaries for every recovery branch.

verified: POSIX active-lock contention, stale-primary recovery after SIGKILL, and escaped rollback-target rejection passed in the executable fixture.
PowerShell source no longer formats argument arrays into errors and suppresses all enrollment command streams; the corresponding static guards passed.
Ubuntu 25.10 arm64 / Node 22.23.3 native systemd fixture passed real npm ci, first install, upgrade, offline rollback, credential/queue preservation, and supervisor SIGKILL restart.
Node 22.22.0 macOS targeted installer/release tests passed: 31 passed, 5 skipped; skips were native Windows-only.
Node 22.23.3 Linux targeted tests passed: 38 passed, 5 skipped; skips were native Windows-only.
Node 22.23.3 Linux full suite passed: 107 files passed, 8 skipped; 1456 tests passed, 21 skipped.
Node 22.22.0 verify, lint, and production build passed on macOS; build included /api/agent/releases.
bash syntax, ShellCheck, and git diff whitespace checks passed for product installer and evaluator script.
execution_notes: The first macOS Node 22 full-suite attempt reused a Node 25 better-sqlite3 binary and was invalid for native-addon cases. The evaluator replaced the symlink with an independent node_modules copy and rebuilt better-sqlite3 under Node 22 before the recorded run.

The corrected macOS Node 22 full suite reached 1455 passed with one existing timing-sensitive failure in tests/cli/agent-lifecycle.test.ts; that file immediately passed 6/6 in isolation. The clean Linux Node 22 full suite passed 1456/1456 non-skipped tests.

The Linux native installer test patches only the advertised repository constant to a local immutable Git fixture. It exercises native Linux filesystem, npm, Node, systemd, and installer behavior, but it is not evidence that the unpublished c8c79cf commit is remotely fetchable.
No production, main branch, human gate, progress.json, or existing host Agent was changed.

ci_decision.reason: deploy-vps.yml pull_request runs Ubuntu Node 22 verification and native windows-latest verification while its deploy job is restricted to main push/workflow_dispatch. The Windows job is the next required evidence, not optional validation.
conditions: Do not push or merge directly to main.
Require both Verify and Verify (Windows) to pass and archive the Windows installer output.
Do not interpret PR CI success as B04 release approval; manifest/tag plus macOS and remaining fault-injection gates still apply.

decision_rule: The candidate may enter non-deploying pull-request CI to obtain native Windows evidence. B04 remains BLOCKED for main/release until a new immutable manifest/tag publishes the accepted Agent commit and native macOS, Windows, and remaining Linux fault-injection gates pass.
